marketing.howSub: Turn one QR scan into a Google review, a new follower, and a customer who comes back.
marketing.howStep1Body: Put a sticker on tables or a flyer in bags. One scan opens your branded game page — no app to install.
marketing.howStep2Body: To unlock the wheel they complete the steps you choose: Google review, Instagram, TripAdvisor, and more.
marketing.howStep3Body: They win a prize and a reason to come back — and you keep the review plus their contact details.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Every customer becomes a player. Every game drives reviews and loyalty.
marketing.heroBody: Boost visibility, build loyalty, and create engagement - starting today.
marketing.heroTrialNote: 7-day free trial on every plan · no credit card until checkout
marketing.pillarsTitle: How we capture, engage, and retain your customers
marketing.scanTitle: Boost the customer experience… with a simple scan
marketing.scanSubtitle: Spark curiosity (and the urge to play)
marketing.scanBody: A sticker on your tables, a flyer in your bags - done! One scan and customers dive into a captivating game that drives Google reviews, social follows, and more.
marketing.funBody: Before they spin, customers complete the steps you configured - Google review, social follow, TripAdvisor, and more.
marketing.visitsBody: Pick the steps and order in your dashboard: review only, social follows, or any combination. Your rules, your flow.
marketing.quoteBody: We partnered with the team and were impressed by their professionalism, speed, and support quality.
marketing.dataBody: See every player, prize won, and contact collected. Export your list as CSV for campaigns.
marketing.prizeTitle: Offer a prize… and a reason to come back
marketing.prizeBody: Set your own redemption rules: next visit, minimum spend, limited time… Turn every game into a loyalty booster.
marketing.easyBody: No long-term lock-in. No setup fees. Welcome to STARSPIN.

marketing.faq1Q: How does the prize wheel work?
marketing.faq1A: Customers scan a QR code in your venue. They complete the steps you configured (Google review, social follow, TripAdvisor, etc.), then spin for a prize you defined.
marketing.faq2Q: How fast will I see results?
marketing.faq2A: Many businesses get their first reviews the same day. Your CRM dashboard tracks spins, contacts, and Google review counts.
marketing.faq3A: Google reviews, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and TripAdvisor. You choose which steps appear and in what order.
marketing.faq4Q: How do I set it up?
marketing.faq4A: Sign up online, configure your wheel, prizes, and branding, download your QR, and place it in-store. You can go live in under 10 minutes.
marketing.cookieText: Hi, we're cookies! Sweeter than nosy 🍪

dashboard.winChanceHint: Percent chance this slice is picked when the wheel stops (10 = 10%). All active prizes must add up to 100%. Wheel slices are equal — only the odds differ.
dashboard.winChancesMustSum100: Active prizes must add up to exactly 100%. Adjust chances or tap Split evenly.
dashboard.winChanceInvalid: Each active prize needs a win chance between 1% and 100%.
